behavior: Switching estimate resets reportComplete before reading, so an old completed report cannot enable the new estimate completion button while pending.
Effect cleanup prevents old success/failure and delayed JSON from committing after switching, closing or unmounting.
Only successful HTTP responses with an array of reports can mark report completion; failure/malformed responses leave action disabled and a later successful read recovers.
